gemini.rationale: The slice documents that FGL Holdings operated independently and grew its assets and equity through 2019, before being acquired by FNF in 2020. Following the acquisition, the F&G segment continued to grow, with its employee base increasing approximately 40% in 2021. There is no documented evidence of product/process disruption or process/organization fracture.

grok.performance_metric: acquired by FNF June 2020 (~$1.8bn cash + 27M shares); F&G segment retained and grew
grok.rationale: The slice documents no product/process interface disruption: FGL Holdings continued filing 10-Ks through FY2019 with rising assets ($30.9bn to $36.7bn) and equity, and after the June 2020 FNF acquisition its insurance operations were retained as a separately disclosed F&G segment issuing the same annuity/life portfolio. No process/organization fracture is documented either; FNF reported F&G segment revenues of $1,233M and net earnings of $136M for the partial year 2020 and an approximately 40% employee-base increase in 2021 as the business continued to grow. Absence of any realized pathway disruption evidence yields p4=0 and p5=0.
